criteria.name: Major
criteria.description: Agent A makes a claim “c” to Agent B about value “v”, action “α”, or state “s”

criteria.name: Minor 1
criteria.description: Claim “c” distorts or misrepresents facts about “v”, “α”, or “s”

criteria.name: Minor 2
criteria.description: A benefits from B accepting the misrepresentation of the relations between “v”, “α”, and “s”

criteria.name: Conclusion
criteria.description: Claim “c” should be scrutinised for misrepresentation

criteria.name: CQ1
criteria.description: In what ways does “c” misrepresent or distort the situation?

criteria.name: CQ2
criteria.description: What evidence exists to verify or falsify “c”?

criteria.name: CQ3
criteria.description: Has A misrepresented in the past?

criteria.name: CQ4
criteria.description: What benefit does A gain by misrepresenting instead of being truthful?

criteria.name: CQ5
criteria.description: Are there independent sources that correct the misrepresentation?
